title: Candidates can't tell why a job is recommended

gate.expects: APPROVE | CHANGES (with notes) | REJECT (with reason), by email reply

approvals.quote: Build the match-reason chips, with the information-value ranking

history.note: Raised verbally at product sync. Captured verbatim in 00-problem.md.
Three options discussed: rename+tooltip, match-reason chips, full explainability surface with weight tuning.

Brainstorm raised the freshness-only objection. Measured signal distribution across 32 seeded jobs: freshness fires on 100% of jobs, roleType on 91%. Objection was mostly wrong, but it exposed a real flaw and changed the design to rank chips by information value rather than score weight.
PM chose match-reason chips including the discriminating/ambient split.
Spec v1 written and pushed to Jira as KAN-15 (182 content blocks, structure verified).

A PM review gate was added between drafting the spec and publishing it. KAN-15 was created under the previous flow, so no Gate 2 approval exists for it - deliberately not backfilled, since a fabricated approval would make every other entry in this log untrustworthy. Gate numbering shifted: Head of Product spec approval is now Gate 3, prototype feedback Gate 4.
